title: Quantum corrections and multioccupancy in a semi-classical gas
summary: The quantum corrections to the behavior of a semi-classical gas can be expressed as a power series of the ratio $eta$ between the cube of De Broglie's thermal wavelength and the specific volume. The connection between $eta$ and the multioccupancy of quantum states is the aim of the present work.
